title: Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast
abstract: arXiv:2610.18877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. We introduce forecast grounding, a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to remain predictive of the future evolution before they are adapted to downstream tasks. We instantiate this principle in LOTUS, which divides each time-series channel into non-overlapping patches and maps them into the LLM embedding space. It then predicts the next patch from the LLM hidden states of the time-series tokens, encouraging the learned representation to retain temporal information. To capture both temporal changes and periodic patterns, we also propose a temporal-spectral patch representation that combines eac

translated_title: Lotus：通过学习预测来学会理解时间序列
translated_abstract: 时间序列语言模型通常使用标签、描述或问答对来将数值信号与语言对齐。尽管这种监督方式有助于形成语言表示，但它并未显式要求这些表示保留底层时间序列信号如何演化的信息。我们提出了预测锚定，这是一种预训练原则，要求与语言对齐的时间序列表示在适应下游任务之前，必须保持对未来演化趋势的预测能力。我们在 LOTUS 中实现了这一原则：该方法将每个时间序列通道划分为不重叠的片段，并将其映射到 LLM 的嵌入空间中；随后，它从时间序列词元的 LLM 隐藏状态预测下一个片段，促使学习到的表示保留时间信息。为了同时捕捉时间变化和周期性模式，我们还提出了一种时间-频谱片段表示，将每个片段的时域与频域特征相结合（原文此处截断）。
tldr: LOTUS 提出“预测锚定”预训练原则，通过要求时间序列的语言对齐表示能够预测未来片段演化，使其在映射到 LLM 嵌入空间时保留时间与频谱信息，从而学会真正理解时间序列。
en_tdlr: LOTUS introduces "forecast grounding," a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to predict future patch evolution, enabling the model to truly understand time-series by preserving temporal and spectral information in LLM embeddings.
